title: Ledger replay W12: a Prime Pack guess retried after a lost answer spends a second token
why: Re-plants the bug POS1M found itself (first real catch, fixed as W12 in #1583): the retried transaction no longer sees its own landed write, so one tap spends both tokens and a right guess's retry answers ROUND_OVER.
ledger: W12 (POS1M first real catch, replay tests/pos1m/replays/L6_PRIME_PACK-70068-044dc9938e.json, fix #1583)
